The integrated grinder and brewing unit deliver the freshest espresso with a perfect grind, dose, tamp and brew every time, removing the guesswork and the mess. The one-touch display panel makes it easy to brew your favorite coffee drinks right at home. Easily froth milk and milk alternatives to craft your favorite drinks such as lattes, cappuccinos, and more. Clean up is simple thanks to our detachable, dishwasher-safe parts. The compact design and sleek interface make this the perfect machine for any space. Brew up your favorites or explore endless possibilities with Magnifica Start.
